checks: Actual team/ledger proposal -> independent nominated grant -> proposer signature; concurrent signatures execute once; same-role outsiders cannot read or decide
Exact currency/amount authority, changed policy and removed reviewer invalidate signing without delivery
Reasoned delegation, participant reminders, higher-role escalation and expiry persist distinct receipts; elapsed time never grants or executes
Mixed batch stores per-item success/failure/blocked receipts; deliberate failed retry is a fresh unsigned proposal and does not repeat successful delivery
Restart recovery preserves signatures and changes interrupted execution to uncertain without repeating the effect
Background batch persists each item, pauses after current effect, resumes only unattempted work, and recovers a completed effect receipt after interruption without automatic replay
An account perspective change hides its former-side proposals and prevents execution until the original perspective is restored
